text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Yaeno Muteki joins us in training as she and Sakura Chiyono O make the final preparations for their debut.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The way you accelerate at the end is amazing, Yaeno! Watching you is teaching me so much about how to use my legs properly!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It is through daily training that we are able to shape our strength, and I'm grateful to have had the opportunity to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I promised my grandfather that I would improve myself at Tracen Academy, so I cannot neglect my training for a single day.
choice_data_list: You've been training every single day?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Correct.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Interesting… Hm…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hehe… Did you see me writing that down?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heh… If he knew the aspirations of our martial style resonated with you as well, Grampa—my grandfather would be proud.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, I've heard that you're Maruzensky's beloved disciple. I have a feeling you already have a goal established within you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Just as I seek out challenges that embody the peak of the racing world, in order to show how much I've learned in my races thus far, so too must you—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The Derby. My dream is to run in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For a moment, the wind comes to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Maruzen entrusted that dream to me, so I won't let anyone else have that race.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno. How about we run 2,400 meters next, the same length as the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wasn't expecting her to make such a suggestion. As her trainer, I know better than to let her run that, so I hurriedly interject.
choice_data_list: You're not ready for that distance yet, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Awww, what? Does this mean you're not letting me do it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that they're finally race-ready, it seems the two of them are eager to test their limits, but they're not considering the strain they might put on their bodies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It won't do if they overexert and exhaust themselves, so I have make sure I supervise and limit how much they train.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Can't we run just a little of it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aww… Fine…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Was that a flicker of fear I felt just now? Just from looking into Chiyono O's eyes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the day of Sakura Chiyono O's debut!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: If I take both the distance of the race and the weather into account, the speed at which I should run down the final stretch should be…
choice_data_list: You've been buried in your notebook all day.
You've been buried in your notebook all day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Of course! These Chiyonotes contain all my priceless proverbs and training details!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I've got to keep prepping until the last second! "Treat each step as a step toward the Derby"—those are my words to live by!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: There's plenty of time until the starting gates open, so I'm going to continue reviewing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Well, yeah. I am.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's about the only saving grace I have.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I don't possess any outstanding natural talent, so I have no choice but to work hard every day.
choice_data_list: You can be pretty bold sometimes, though.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Huh?
choice_data_list: Like when you wanted to run the Derby's length of 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haha… Sorry about putting you on the spot then, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …But the Derby is the one race I have to win, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From what happened recently with Yaeno Muteki, I know how sincere her wish is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: The Derby. My dream is to run in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second Maruzensky was brought up, the look in her eyes completely changed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Trainer?
choice_data_list: You're not the type to let anyone take your dream from you.
You're not the type to let anyone take your dream from you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Of course not! Well, I'm off to the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O puts down her hefty notebook and phone on the desk, and she heads off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her notebook, stuffed with all sorts of sticky notes and papers, embodies all the hard work she's put in… as well as her desire for what's to come.
